key_reasoning.reason: New module family (per-layer Bedrock resolver, switch planner with backup manifest, prompt) plus three entry-point hook-ups (AgentCLI.handleRun, install.ts, connect-orchestrator), edits to shared modules (claude-settings-env.ts, routing.ts exports) and two connectors (desktop.ts, vscode-claude-code.ts). 4+ components across several subsystems with new abstractions.

Closest patterns are vscode-claude-code.ts (JSONC edits), desktop.ts writeDesktopConfig, the .codemie-backup snapshot in claude-code-otlp.ts and launch-project-prompt.ts. None covers a multi-file backup with manifest under ~/.codemie/backups, managed-settings.d, macOS plist or Windows registry readers, so there is no exact precedent. The change rewrites users' own config files, including git-tracked project settings, and gate ordering differs across three flows. Changing malformed-file semantics in readClaudeSettingsEnv affects its OTLP caller. Claude precedence and Desktop behaviour are only verified through the brief's repro. The ACs enumerate many source classes and error paths, but a real-tmp-dir test template with injected platform and env exists, so no extra bump. Not scored XL because the work is local-filesystem only and a backup makes it reversible.

Roughly 8-12 modified files (AgentCLI.ts, install.ts, connect-orchestrator.ts, claude-settings-env.ts, routing.ts, desktop.ts, vscode-claude-code.ts, interactive helpers, existing tests that mock the settings module) and 5-8 new files (resolver, switcher/backup, prompt, plus tests per source class). This spans several directories (cli, agents/core, agents/plugins, proxy connectors).

CLI/UI prompt and exit handling, agent and service logic (detection, planning), file persistence (settings, Desktop config, VS Code settings, backups), and external-tool configuration (Claude Code, Desktop, VS Code, platform managed sources). No schema migration, so L rather than XL.
